parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language in which the returned results are displayed. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the Intra-zone Provider First feature.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The name of the Microservices Engine (MSE) namespace

parameters.name: Rules
parameters.description: This parameter is reserved and not in use.

parameters.name: Threshold
parameters.description: The threshold for the Intra-zone Provider First feature to take effect. If the percentage of instances of the application that are deployed in a zone exceeds the specified threshold, the Intra-zone Provider First feature is enabled for the zone. This indicates that when a consumer initiates a request to the application, the request is preferentially routed to an instance in the same zone as the consumer.
